parameters.name: EndpointID
parameters.description: The unique USP identifier of the USP Endpoint.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Expected password to be used by the USP Endpoint to authenticate. If set to an empty string, the USP Endpoint will be unable to authenticate successsfully on Unix Domain Sockets requiring authentication.

object.description: This object contains the authentication details for USP Endpoints connecting to Unix Domain Sockets requiring authentication. Endpoints not present in this table will be unable to authenticate successsfully on Unix Domain Sockets requiring authentication.
